title: A Busy Day for Ana
text:
Ana wakes up early. She has a shower and eats a banana for breakfast. Then she takes the bus to work. Ana works in a small bakery.

At lunch time, Ana eats a sandwich in the park. In the afternoon, she helps customers at the bakery. After work, she cooks dinner with her sister. Ana goes to bed at ten o'clock.

questions.text: What does Ana eat for breakfast?
What time does Ana go to bed?
How does Ana probably feel about her job?
options: She seems to enjoy helping people
She is afraid of her customers

questions.text: Why does Ana probably take the bus to work?
options: Because her work is not near her home
Because she does not have a bicycle
Because the bus is free only today
Because she is afraid to walk

a shop that sells bread, cakes and other baked food
people who buy things from a shop or service

paragraph_translations: Ana acorda cedo. Ela toma banho e come uma banana no café da manhã. Depois, pega o ônibus para o trabalho. Ana trabalha em uma padaria pequena.
Na hora do almoço, Ana come um sanduíche no parque. À tarde, ela atende os clientes na padaria. Depois do trabalho, ela cozinha o jantar com a irmã. Ana vai para a cama às dez horas.
